abstract: The possibility of hyperthermic therapy for choriocarcinoma was fundamentally analyzed in an in vitro study. The temperature sensitivity of choriocarcinoma cells designated GCH-nu-YS clone was examined using a severely controlled temperature gradient incubator (T.G.I.). The cells were placed into an atmosphere at various temperatures (37.0-41.2 degrees C) for about 2 weeks and the inhibitory effect on cell proliferation was chronologically investigated in addition to degenerative changes in cellular morphology. When the temperature was not higher than 39.2 degrees C the proliferation of YS clone was nearly the same as that of the cells cultured at 37.0 degrees C. Proliferation at 39.5-39.6 degrees C, however, was slightly inhibited. And when cultured at over 39.9 degrees C, it was markedly inhibited. Above 40.4 degrees C, cell proliferation was impossible, thus resulting in destruction of the cells. These data suggest that the temperature upper limit for viability (TLV) is approximately 40.4-40.6 degrees C and the temperature upper limit for proliferation (TLP) is approximately 40.1-40.2 degrees C. When Okumura's method of classification according to temperature sensitivity is applied, the choriocarcinoma cells may be regarded as having the characteristics of adenocarcinoma. Morphological findings for cells treated at TLV revealed enlargement of the cytoplasm, an increase in the number of perinuclear granules and the appearance of deformed cells such as bizarre cells.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、絨毛癌に対する温熱療法の可能性を基礎的に解析した。絨毛癌細胞GCH-nu-YSクローンの温度感受性を、厳密に制御された温度勾配インキュベータ(T.G.I.)を用いて検討した。細胞を37.0～41.2℃の各温度に約2週間置き、細胞増殖の抑制効果を経時的に調べるとともに、細胞形態の変性所見を観察した。39.2℃以下ではYSクローンの増殖は37.0℃で培養した細胞とほぼ同等であった。しかし39.5～39.6℃では増殖がわずかに抑制され、39.9℃以上では著明に抑制された。40.4℃以上では細胞増殖は不可能となり、細胞は破壊された。これらのデータから、生存可能温度の上限(TLV)は約40.4～40.6℃、増殖可能温度の上限(TLP)は約40.1～40.2℃と推定された。奥村の温度感受性分類法を適用すると、絨毛癌細胞は腺癌の特性を持つと考えられた。TLVで処理した細胞の形態学的所見は、細胞質の拡大、核周囲顆粒の増加、奇怪細胞などの変形細胞の出現であった。
